action.custom: On a sunlit tropical stone garden terrace, an adult woman in a balanced front three-quarter stance, face toward camera, both empty open hands apart beside her hips. Two red flower hair ornaments, green and yellow overlapping leaf-shaped skirt plates, slim green enamel armor and red accents. Full body and footwear with clear margins. Both human hands fully visible and anatomically connected to their own forearms, one thumb and four separate natural fingers per hand. No weapons, text or logos. Portrait 2:3.
